probe.private_reasoning: The language in the second round strongly suggests that Aldous Finch LLP views the USD 13,000,000 Purchase Price as a non-negotiable term, emphasizing its importance to them. Their insistence presents a firm bottom line that they may be unwilling to move from, indicating that this figure is critical in their negotiations. Additionally, the lack of flexibility on the Purchase Price in the second communication implies they are motivated to defend this figure rigorously, likely due to either an internal valuation or company policy. Their willingness to discuss indemnity indicates that while they might be prepared to adjust other terms, they have firmly established this price as their boundary. Thus, my assessment leads me to believe that the minimum Purchase Price they are committed to is USD 13,000,000 due to its explicit identification as non-negotiable.
